title: Transfer with cleanup discipline
prompt: Implement `static decimal Transfer(decimal from, decimal to, decimal amount)` inside a running total model: throws `ArgumentException` for non-positive amount, throws `InvalidOperationException` when `amount > from`, otherwise returns `to + amount`. Also implement `static bool AuditTrail(List<string> log, Action action)`: runs `action`, always appending `"done"` to the log afterwards (even when action throws, log gets `"done"` and the exception propagates); returns true only if action completed without throwing.

tests.name: transfer
tests.hint: Argument validation and state validation stay distinct exception types.

tests.name: audit
tests.hint: finally semantics: the append happens on both paths; only the return value differs.
